scripts.dev: export NODE_ENV=development && pnpm run build && pnpm run start
scripts.test:radar: pnpm exec esbuild src/lib/radar.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:better-sqlite3 --outfile=dist/radar.test.mjs && node --test dist/radar.test.mjs
scripts.test:upload-security: mkdir -p .test-dist && pnpm exec esbuild src/lib/url-fetch.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=.test-dist/url-fetch.test.mjs && node --test .test-dist/url-fetch.test.mjs
